name: mirage
text:
v1.0.11 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.11

In it:
- The bet slip fix from v1.0.10.
- The Live tab has a Paper records section. For the lower tier (model 75-89% sure) and the score-event buys it shows bets, how many settled, wins against what the model said, and return after fees. Bets are graded from ESPN final scores.
- Settings › Live bids has Paper records with real money: a switch for each of the two tiers, and a stake that is either a typed dollar amount or a Kelly fraction of your wallet. They only buy while 'Buy tail bets with real money' is on, under your game, day and loss limits.
- SX Bet live scores are read as a backup when ESPN has no live game (like Cleveland @ Tampa). Only MLB scores from SX can drive real orders. For clocked sports, SX's periodTime isn't verified, so those are paper only for now.

Not built:
- BoltOdds live scores. They aren't in your Pro plan and I've never seen a real frame, so a parser would be a guess. The Test key listen has to record one first.
- Per-game socket odds against Novig on the Live board. The consensus check already runs behind the scenes, but the board doesn't show it yet.
- Cross-exchange records are still only a journal. They aren't on the Live board or graded.
